BiblicalUsage: Yâpheh is the ordinary word for beautiful, for what is fair to look on. They sought a fair damsel for aged David, and found Abishag, and the young David himself was ruddy and of a beautiful countenance when Samuel anointed him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God looks on the heart, but He is not blind to beauty, and He chose a beautiful shepherd to be king.
